description:
Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the US operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities:


 Support central projects to drive platform growth and achieve multiple targets, including but not limited to campaigns, affiliate, content scenarios, shoptab.
 Able to conduct meticulous resource management, market research and other operational works with moderate guidance.
 Coordinate related cross-functional teams' resources to ensure the normal and orderly development and implementation of the projects
 Communicate with back-end support teams to keep optimizing infrastructure construction
 Conduct consistent tracking of project performance metrics as required. Able to identify and come up with improvement plans for responsible projects.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Able to commit to a minimum working duration of 6 months or 1 year
 Experience in with short video, live stream and content-based e-commerce in the local market.
 Proactive self-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience on commerce platforms or leading Internet companies.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
Ubicación:

Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Si te apasiona el shopper marketing, quieres entender el comportamiento del consumidor y te motiva aprender sobre la ejecución comercial de marcas líderes ¡esta posición es para ti!

Como Trade Marketing Trainee apoyarás en la implementación de estrategias comerciales centradas en el shopper, colaborando con equipos multifuncionales para una ejecución impecable en el punto de venta. Tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar distintas habilidades en un entorno colaborativo, contribuyendo directamente al crecimiento de nuestras categorías.

Principales Responsabilidades:

Participarás en la creación e implementación de proyectos de trade marketing, orientados a mejorar la experiencia de compra y fortalecer la presencia de nuestras marcas en el punto de venta.

Formarás parte de un equipo multifuncional en el que podrás desarrollar habilidades de liderazgo, planeación y trabajo en equipo.

Colaborarás en el análisis de datos y desempeño comercial para generar aprendizajes y propuestas que impulsen los resultados del área.

Perfil proactivo, orientado a resultados, analítico y con alto sentido de responsabilidad.

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

¿Cómo ser exitoso en el rol y en Ferrero?

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

title: MKT Finance & Procurement Operations Intern
skills: Supporting budget management and tracking, helping maintain accurate visibility of marketing spend, commitments, pending items and budget execution
Managing key procurement and vendor processes, including purchase requests, POs, contracts and approval follow-ups.
Supporting billing, reconciliation and payment processes, ensuring invoices are correctly matched against POs, approved scopes and previous billings.
Maintaining accurate operational controls and trackers, proactively identifying pending items, aging, deadlines and potential risks.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing Operations Analyst and cross functional teams such as Finance, Procurement and Legal to solve operational issues and keep processes moving on time.
Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, using data, technology and AI to make our ways of working more efficient.
You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Business or a related field.

You are comfortable working with numbers and data and have strong interest in forecasting processes, accruals/amortization, P&L statements, and budget management tools. Have strong attention to detail and good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
You are highly organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines at the same time.
You are curious, enjoy solving problems and challenging existing ways of working, and are always looking for opportunities to improve.
You are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how AI can be used to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
You are comfortable communicating in English and Spanish in a professional environment.
Previous internship or work experience is a plus, but not required — we care more about your learning agility, ownership and willingness to grow.
description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a motivated and detail oriented Marketing Operations Intern with a strong focus on finance and procurement processes. In this role, you will support budget management, financial analysis, and vendor coordination to ensure smooth operations between marketing, finance, and procurement teams. You will also contribute to process automation that would help generate business insights that improve decision making.

This role is a great opportunity to understand how a large Marketing organization operates behind the scenes, gain exposure to different stakeholders and develop strong operational, analytical and problem solving skills.

In this role, you'll be...


Supporting budget management and tracking, helping maintain accurate visibility of marketing spend, commitments, pending items and budget execution 
Managing key procurement and vendor processes, including purchase requests, POs, contracts and approval follow-ups.
Supporting billing, reconciliation and payment processes, ensuring invoices are correctly matched against POs, approved scopes and previous billings.
Maintaining accurate operational controls and trackers, proactively identifying pending items, aging, deadlines and potential risks.
Working closely with the Senior Marketing Operations Analyst and cross functional teams such as Finance, Procurement and Legal to solve operational issues and keep processes moving on time.
Identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, using data, technology and AI to make our ways of working more efficient.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Business or a related field.
You are comfortable working with numbers and data and have strong interest in forecasting processes, accruals/amortization, P&L statements, and budget management tools. Have strong attention to detail and good knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
You are highly organized, proactive and comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines at the same time.
You are curious, enjoy solving problems and challenging existing ways of working, and are always looking for opportunities to improve.
You are comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day work and are curious about how AI can be used to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
You are comfortable communicating in English and Spanish in a professional environment.
Previous internship or work experience is a plus, but not required — we care more about your learning agility, ownership and willingness to grow.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
Objetivo del puesto

Transformar los objetivos de negocio y las necesidades de los clientes en estrategias de marketing fundamentadas en investigación, análisis de datos, conocimiento del consumidor y oportunidades de mercado.

Será responsable de desarrollar diagnósticos estratégicos, identificar insights relevantes, definir objetivos y KPIs, construir planes de acción y evaluar el desempeño de las estrategias implementadas, generando recomendaciones que contribuyan al crecimiento de las marcas y al cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.

Responsabilidades principales

A. Investigación y diagnóstico estratégico

Analizar el mercado, la categoría, la competencia, las tendencias de consumo y el entorno digital de cada cliente.
Investigar audiencias, comportamientos, motivaciones, necesidades y barreras de compra.
Desarrollar diagnósticos de marca, comunicación, posicionamiento y desempeño digital.
Identificar oportunidades de diferenciación, crecimiento, adquisición y conversión.

Traducir hallazgos de investigación en insights accionables y oportunidades estratégicas.

B. Desarrollo de estrategias y planes de marketing

Desarrollar estrategias de marketing alineadas con los objetivos de negocio, marketing y comunicación de cada cliente.
Construir plataformas estratégicas, territorios de comunicación, propuestas de valor y mensajes clave.

Asegurar que las recomendaciones estén respaldadas por datos, investigación y razonamiento estratégico.

C. Análisis de desempeño y seguimiento de KPIs

Definir, en coordinación con las áreas especialistas y los responsables de cuenta, los KPIs que permitan evaluar el éxito de cada estrategia.
Revisar periódicamente los resultados de campañas, canales y acciones de marketing.
Analizar tendencias, variaciones, desviaciones y oportunidades de mejora.
Contrastar los resultados obtenidos con los objetivos establecidos y los benchmarks disponibles.
Identificar las causas potenciales del bajo desempeño y formular hipótesis para mejorar los resultados.
Generar recomendaciones para optimizar campañas, presupuestos, audiencias, mensajes y canales.
Dar seguimiento a las acciones correctivas propuestas y evaluar su impacto.

description:
Remote, Mexico preferred (LATAM welcome, Mexico City hours) · Full-time




Pálpito is a prediction market for Latin America. People take positions on the outcome of real events, from elections and the economy to sports, weather and culture, at prices that reflect what the crowd thinks will happen. We are live and operating, built around local payment methods and local markets, with a small, AI-first team working across the region.




We are hiring the person to lead Pálpito's growth: a builder who designs and runs it across every channel, paid, organic, creators and partners, and does much of the work themselves. You will own how Pálpito acquires users who fund their account, make a first trade and come back. You set up campaigns, brief creators and build landing pages and dashboards yourself, because that is how the best growth people move. You decide where the next peso goes based on cost per funded trader, not clicks, and what to hand to agencies and freelancers.




What you'll own

Integrated campaigns around real events. Elections, the Liga MX playoffs, the World Cup, the weather: one idea carried across paid, organic, creators, PR and CRM, live within days of the news.
Paid acquisition across platforms. Meta, TikTok, Google (search and YouTube), X and programmatic. You test new platforms, scale the ones that bring funded traders and cut the rest.
Programmatic and new formats. Display, video and connected TV through DSPs when they earn their budget, and formats that fit our markets, such as live-event placements.

Organic, community and referrals. With the content team, social, WhatsApp communities and our referral program run as growth channels.
Partnerships and media. Co-marketing with media, apps and brands that reach our audience.

Tracking and attribution, with engineering. Every sign-up, deposit and trade traced to the channel, campaign and creative that brought it in.
The funnel and the weekly numbers. From first visit to sign-up, first deposit and first trade, by channel and cohort, and a Friday read-out on spend, cost per funded trader and what changes next week.
Policy, compliance and quality. You know how platforms classify and restrict advertisers in our category and keep our accounts healthy with our legal team. You catch fake accounts, reward abuse and low-quality traffic early.




Who thrives here

You are a builder. You set up the pixel, build the landing page, edit the video and launch the test yourself, and you are proud of it.
You ship weekly experiments and stop the ones that don't work.
You can take an idea on Monday to a campaign live across three channels by Friday.
You use AI tools to move faster: creative variations, copy, analysis and reporting.
You do not trust a number until you know where it came from, and you judge channels by funded, active users, not reach or clicks.
You push back on agencies, platforms and founders with data, respectfully and fast.




What we're looking for

Four to six years in growth or performance marketing at a consumer product, ideally fintech, e-commerce or another regulated category, with results in at least three channels, paid and non-paid.
Hands-on with paid social and search, and exposure to programmatic.
You have run creator or UGC programs end to end.
You have launched at least one integrated campaign around a cultural or news moment.
Comfortable building without engineers: landing pages, no-code tools, tracking setups, basic SQL or analytics.
Experience managing agencies or freelancers and holding them to a number.
Experience marketing to users in Mexico or Latin America.
Native Spanish and professional English. Both are required: you will work with the team and partners in both languages.




A solid plus: web3 experience, especially marketing a web3 or crypto product.




Nice to have: experience with ad platform policies in restricted categories, launching a product in a new market, or growing an online community.




What we offer

A competitive salary plus real equity. Everyone on the team gets equity.
Fully remote, based in Mexico or elsewhere in LATAM, with working hours that overlap Mexico City.
Regular in-person team onsites.
Full ownership of growth, working directly with the founders.




How to apply

Applying through LinkedIn alone is not enough. To be considered, send an email to hiring@palpito.com with the subject "Growth Marketing Lead: [your name]" that includes:

An intro letter. Who you are and what you have built.
Why you are the right person to lead Pálpito's growth. Be specific about what you would bring and where you would start.
A growth story from a previous role. A channel or campaign you grew: where it started, what you changed, the results, what it cost per converted user, and what you would do differently today.

Applications without this email will not be reviewed.




The process is an intro call, a conversation about your career, and a practical case on real, anonymized Pálpito campaign and funnel data. You will meet several people on the team along the way. We read every email and aim to reply within a week.

title: Especialista en Marketing de Contenido
description:
Especialista en Marketing de Contenido




Nodux, en alianza con WES México, abre una posición de Especialista en Marketing de Contenido y Desarrollo Comercial en México. Es una posición ideal para personas jóvenes que están dando sus primeros pasos en marketing de contenido, o que planean hacerlo.




SOBRE NODUX

Nodux es una startup latinoamericana de software (SaaS) que desarrolla el sistema operativo del taller: una plataforma que integra la gestión de reparaciones, alquiler y ventas en una sola aplicación. Atendemos a empresas de servicio técnico y talleres en Costa Rica, México, Colombia y Centroamérica.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Diseñar y ejecutar el marketing de contenido de Nodux y, a la vez, generar negocio: atraer y convertir a dueños de talleres y empresas de servicio técnico mediante contenido en redes y outreach directo, con un tono cercano y auténtico. No es un rol de marketing clásico: buscamos a alguien que ame crear y editar en redes (no solo planificar), cómodo con la cámara y con olfato comercial.




RESPONSABILIDADES

• Grabar, editar y publicar video corto (reels, TikTok) en los editores nativos de TikTok e Instagram.

• Crear contenido híbrido con WES México: además del contenido de Nodux, producir contenido en conjunto con WES para ambas marcas.

• Ventas directas y outreach, incluida prospección en LinkedIn: contactar talleres y empresas de servicio técnico y empujar prospectos hacia la demo.

• Diseñar y mantener el calendario de contenido (redes, video, blog y correo).

• Redactar copy para campañas, casos de éxito, guías y artículos optimizados para SEO.

• Armar secuencias de email y mensajes de prospección.

• Registrar y dar seguimiento a los prospectos en el CRM.

• Medir el desempeño (alcance, prospectos y conversión) y optimizar con datos.




REQUISITOS

• Crítico: capacidad comprobable de edición de reels y video corto en los editores nativos de TikTok e Instagram (y/o CapCut), con redes propias congruentes que lo demuestren (no hace falta ser mega influencer).

• Perfil comercial: facilidad para ventas directas y outreach, sin miedo a prospectar.

• Extroversión y personalidad carismática, que conecte frente a la cámara y con clientes.

• Buena redacción en español y nociones de SEO y analítica de contenido.

• Autonomía, orientación a resultados y mentalidad de startup.

• Abierto o abierta a aprender growth hacking: la estrategia de Nodux crece por ese camino.

• 2 o más años en marketing de contenido o redes, idealmente B2B o SaaS.




DESEABLE

• Formación (o en curso) en marketing, comunicación o relaciones públicas.

• Conocimiento de marketing digital y SEO.

• Adobe (Premiere Pro, Photoshop) como plus.

• Nociones de diseño (Canva, Figma).

• Manejo de un CRM (HubSpot u otro).

• Inglés intermedio.




QUÉ OFRECEMOS

• Trabajo cercano con el liderazgo de Nodux desde Costa Rica, como mano derecha del fundador, con mentoría directa en growth y estrategia.

• Autonomía creativa y la posibilidad de construir el área de contenido desde su base.

• Esquema híbrido con base en México, mayormente remoto.




CONDICIONES

• Sueldo: $18,000 MXN mensuales.

• Esquema de contratación: asimilados a salarios.

• Jornada: lunes a viernes, 8:00 a 18:00.

• Modalidad: híbrido, Naucalpan de Juárez, Estado de México.




PROCESO DE RECLUTAMIENTO (en alianza con WES México)

Recepción de perfiles, preselección y entrevistas, prueba técnica, oferta e incorporación.




Contacto: Esteban Guerrero, esteban@nodux.link, nodux.link

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Web Experimentation and Operations Associate

Location: Remote – Mexico

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (fixed term, full-time)

Industry: Technology & IT / Digital Marketing

Compensation: $2,167–$2,667 USD/month

Schedule: Full-time | Business hours (time zone to be confirmed with the client)

English Proficiency: C1 (Excellent spoken and written English)

Start Date: December 15, 2026

About The Role

Our client is a global financial technology company that serves consumers, small businesses, and mid-market companies worldwide. The team this role supports works on web experiences for mid-market offerings that help growing businesses manage financial operations, payroll, payments, and marketing in one place.

This is a full-time, fixed-term contract role through December 14, 2027, supporting the repeatable parts of mid-market web work, including hub pages, CMS-related work, and related web operations.

This is a support role. The engagement lead sets priorities, writes hypotheses, and makes decisions. You will build, check, update, and draft from templates and clear instructions, and flag anything that is unclear. Work is reviewed before it ships. The role does not include deciding test results, signing off on launches or tests, making budget or vendor decisions, managing employees, or publishing without approval.

This opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who is comfortable with experimentation setups, web QA, status tracking, and light automation, and who writes clear, short, accurate updates on time.

Why This Opportunity?


Clear, defined work with templates, instructions, and review before anything ships
A mix of experimentation support, web operations, launch support, and light automation
Hands-on experience with mid-market web work at a global financial technology company
A support structure in which the engagement lead sets priorities and decisions, so you can focus on precise execution


What You'll Do

Test and Offer Support (~45%)


Set up experiments and offers in the company's internal experimentation and campaign platforms, following approved specs
QA each build in preview, across browsers and mobile, and log issues
Fill in the readout template with results from the analytics team and the test tool. The engagement lead writes the conclusion
Target one light test setup per month from month 3, growing over time


Web Operations Hygiene and Launch Support (~40%)


Keep status and dates current each week in Quickbase, Jira, and Airtable, and keep the web project register updated
Run UAT checklists on new and re-themed pages, log issues, and confirm fixes
Draft launch announcements and change notes from templates for approval


Light Automation (~15%)


Run and monitor existing scheduled reports, and flag failures
Build small reports and automations on request using Claude and approved tools, with review
Write a short note for each automation (what it does, what it reads, and who to ask)


Tools you will use include internal experimentation and campaign platforms, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and Edge Delivery Services, Contentstack, Quickbase, Jira, Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace, and Claude.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications


1-3 years of experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics
Strong attention to detail, and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists
Experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools (Jira, Airtable, or similar)
Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written updates
Asks for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting
C1 English (excellent spoken and written English)
Based in Colombia, Mexico, or Chile, and able to work fully remotely in a full-time capacity


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with A/B testing or personalization tools (Optimizely, Adobe Target, VWO, or similar)
Day-to-day use of Claude or another AI assistant
Basic SQL or scripting
Familiarity with Quickbase, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), or Contentstack


Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:


Attention to detail and comfort following specs, templates, and checklists
Clear, short, accurate, and on-time written communication
Asking for help early when something is unclear, rather than waiting
Hands-on experience with spreadsheets and ticketing or work-management tools
Ability to work effectively in a support role, with work reviewed before it ships
Relevant experience in marketing, web operations, or analytics (1-3 years)
C1 spoken and written English
Availability to work full-time and remotely from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile


How Success Is Measured


Experiments and offers go live accurately and on schedule, with QA issues caught before they reach production
Test readouts are complete on time, so the engagement lead can draw conclusions without missing inputs
From month 3, light test setups are delivered at the agreed monthly pace and increase over time
The team can rely on a current weekly view of status, dates, and the web project register
New and re-themed pages complete UAT with issues resolved before launch
Launch communications are ready for approval when needed, so releases are not delayed
Scheduled reports stay reliable, failures are flagged quickly, and new automations are documented for handover
The engagement lead can trust your written updates and early flags, with minimal rework


Why Join Us


Fully remote opportunity from Colombia, Mexico, or Chile

Proven experience working directly with C-suite and executive leadership, advising and presenting to senior stakeholders.

Solid media relations background, including experience delivering media training to executives and industry stakeholders.
Proven experience developing, implementing and monitoring crisis communications plans.

Proven experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to improve productivity, content development and analysis.
Working knowledge of marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Canva, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Analytics.
Proven experience in performance reporting: tracking team time, consolidating metrics from multiple sources and turning data into actionable recommendations.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and Spanish.

Experience in the agriculture, food or beverage sectors, or with trade associations.
Experience in an agency or consulting environment serving U.S.-based clients.
Project management certification (PMP or equivalent).

Travel: Regional and international travel as needed for client meetings and events.
Documentation: Valid passport and U.S. visa required.

Contract: Full-time independent contractor engagement, with potential to become an employee depending on performance and business needs. Official national holidays are observed.

description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

title: Shopify CRO Implementation Specialist
description:
Who We Are:




At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.




What We Do:




We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start email marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take email marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.




Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.







Summary of The Position:




The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.




Responsibilities:




• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.




Our Culture:




• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.




Required Skills:




• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.




Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands




This Role Is Perfect for You If…




- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!




This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

description:
At 3Dtracking, we build technology that makes complex fleet operations easier. Easier to manage, easier to scale and easier to trust. With over 20 years in the industry and a platform used in 150+ countries, we are a globally recognised leader in white-labeled telematics. Our software powers mission-critical fleet operations for thousands of service providers across six continents. But what sets us apart is not just the tech; it is how we support our partners, evolve with them and help them succeed in a complex industry.




Overview of the Role:  The KAM owns and develops a portfolio of 3Dtracking white-label partners, with a clear mandate to empower those partners to thrive. This is a proactive, commercially minded relationship role. The KAM is expected to understand each partner’s business, customers, priorities, risks and growth ambitions and to act as an extension of the partner’s business while representing 3Dtracking’s interests with sound judgement.  The role goes beyond relationship maintenance and issue resolution. KAMs are expected to create value before being asked - identifying growth opportunities, strengthening adoption, spotting risk early, guiding and nurturing partners and mobilising the right internal teams to deliver. They take ownership of the partner relationship from onboarding and handover through ongoing development, retention, expansion and where necessary, recovery. Success in the role is measured by the quality and health of the partner relationship, sustainable commercial growth, disciplined account management and the KAM’s ability to lead calmly and decisively when things become difficult. 




Responsibility

Strategic Partner Ownership & Relationship Leadership

•      Own the overall relationship and success of an assigned portfolio of white-label partners, taking accountability for the health, retention and development of each account.

•      Build trusted, multi-level relationships and become a credible extension of the partner’s business, understanding how they make money, who their customers are, where they are under pressure and what they are trying to achieve.

•      Maintain an informed view of partner activity, priorities, product use, commercial position, sentiment, risks and opportunities; ensure no important account becomes “quiet” or surprises the business.

•      Create and maintain strategic account plans for priority partners, with clear relationship, retention and growth priorities.

Proactive Partner Engagement & Value Creation

•      Move the relationship from reactive support to proactive partnership: bring ideas, insight, product knowledge and opportunities to partners before they need to ask.

•      Maintain an appropriate operating rhythm of operational, alignment and strategic conversations based on partner tier and need.

•      Guide and nurture partners in how they use, position and derive value from the 3Dtracking platform, including appropriate training and capability refreshers.

•      Ensure partner meetings have clear outcomes, actions and documented context so commitments do not depend on memory or individuals.

Partner Growth & Commercial Expansion

•      Identify where value is being left on the table and translate partner needs, customer opportunities and underused platform capability into commercially viable growth opportunities.

•      Lead proactive growth conversations focused on the partner’s business outcomes rather than simply presenting features.

•      Build a credible view of expansion potential, retention risk and commercial risk across the portfolio and contribute to accurate forecasting.

•      Work with Sales and other commercial colleagues where opportunities require broader commercial support, while retaining ownership of the ongoing partner relationship.

Retention, Risk & Partner Recovery

•      Retain partners in a flexible, non-contracted commercial model where value must be demonstrated continuously.

•      Detect early warning signals such as declining engagement, recurring dissatisfaction, unresolved delivery issues, competitive pressure, payment concerns or changing sentiment and act before they become escalations.

•      Own the coordination of recovery plans for at-risk relationships, with clear accountability, milestones, communication and internal escalation.

•      When trust is damaged, shift the conversation from defensive to accountable: acknowledge shortfalls, clarify what success requires, align expectations and follow through visibly.

•      Escalate material partner concerns early and intelligently; repeated dissatisfaction or significant commercial/reputational risk should trigger the appropriate leadership review.

Negotiation & Difficult Partner Conversations

•      Lead partner negotiations by understanding the interests & pressures behind stated positions and seeking outcomes that create sustainable value for both the partner and 3Dtracking.

•      Prepare for important conversations, explore before proposing, & agree clear actions, owners and expectations.

•      Handle difficult behaviour with calmness and structure, acknowledge, clarify, align and act without becoming defensive or overpromising.

•      Be willing to have tough conversations externally with partners & internally within 3Dtracking when this is in the best interests of the relationship and the business.

Product, Support & Delivery Alignment

•      Act as the partner’s informed advocate internally, translating business requirements and operational impact into clear context for Product, Support, Development and other teams.

•      Coordinate visibility and follow-through on material tickets, product commitments & partner dependencies; ensure partners receive timely, meaningful updates rather than having to chase for information.

•      Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions or proposed solutions constructively & ensure important partner needs are sufficiently understood before commitments are made.

•      Where appropriate, support controlled pilots/beta rollouts & partner validation before wider deployment, particularly where a solution is business-critical.

Onboarding & Sales-to-KAM Transition

•      Take structured ownership of newly signed partners following Sales handover, ensuring commercial commitments, expectations, key stakeholders, risks and opportunities are understood.

•      Coordinate onboarding milestones and ensure the partner experiences a smooth, confidence-building transition from sale to ongoing relationship management.

•      Build early credibility through clarity, responsiveness and delivery, establishing the KAM as the partner’s primary relationship owner.

Commercial & Financial Discipline

•      Understand the commercial profile of each partner, including recurring revenue, growth potential, retention risk, payment health & opportunities for expansion.

•      Proactively follow up overdue invoices in line with agreed processes & treat payment behaviour as a potential relationship & business-health signal, not simply an administrative matter.

•      Balance partner advocacy with commercial judgement.

CRM, Account Intelligence & Reporting

•      Maintain accurate, current account information, meeting notes, actions, risks, opportunities & relevant activity in HubSpot and agreed internal systems.

•      Use account data and partner insight to provide management with a clear view of relationship health, growth opportunities, forecast, risk and required interventions.  Capture market, competitor and partner intelligence and feed relevant insights into Product, Sales, Marketing and leadership decision-making.

Cross-Functional & Internal Commercial Leadership

•      Build strong working relationships across Sales, Product, Support, Dev, Finance and leadership to create a seamless partner experience.

•      Influence internal priorities using clear commercial and partner context rather than simply passing on requests.

•      Take end-to-end ownership -bring the right people together, keep actions moving & close the loop with the partner.

•      Contribute to a culture in which partner success, retention and growth are shared business priorities rather than the responsibility of one function.




Requirements, qualifications, skills & experience

·      4+ years of experience in Key Account Management, Partner Management, Customer Success, B2B SaaS or a comparable commercial relationship role; experience in channel/white label & in telematics and/or fleet technology is essential.

·      Proven ability to manage complex, long-term B2B relationships across different markets, cultures & stakeholder levels.

·      Working understanding of GPS/telematics devices, video telematics & platform configuration, sufficient to prioritize issues, assess partner impact & engage the Support and Development teams.

·      Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify retention risk, expansion opportunity & the business impact behind partner requests.

·      Demonstrated ability to lead difficult conversations, negotiate constructively & recover relationships when trust or delivery is under pressure.

·      Excellent judgement, ownership and follow-through; comfortable influencing internally without relying on formal authority.

·      Confident working cross-functionally with Product, Support, Development, Sales, Finance & leadership.

·      Strong written & verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical or operational complexity for different audiences.

·      Disciplined account management and CRM habits; experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM platform.  

Self-directed, resilient, proactive; able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.

·      Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese.  Willingness to travel locally & internationally when required.  Time-zone flexibility for global partners.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What You Bring

You come from the world of law; but you’ve never been content with how things have always been done. You may have started out at a top-tier law firm. Maybe you’ve worked in a corporate legal team, seeing thorny operational problems from the inside. Perhaps you've even tried disrupting the status-quo through a legal tech company, or ventures of your own. Either way, you've had experience beyond the traditional legal career path. description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

As an Installation Coordinator, you’ll be responsible for orchestrating and monitoring Samsara hardware installations across customer fleets. You will ensure that each deployment is carried out according to technical and operational standards, working closely with Implementation consultants, Account Executives, Partners, and Internal stakeholders to guarantee a successful customer experience from the start.

This is a critical and detail-oriented role that blends project coordination, field operations knowledge, and customer success. Your work ensures our customers’ first touchpoint with Samsara’s technology is smooth, impactful, and aligned with our quality and safety standards.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will: 
Coordinate pre-installation logistics with partners.
Validate customer and site readiness, including cable availability and configuration.
Ensure the Statement of Work (SOW) is fully understood and achievable before kickoff.
Track real-time installation progress, ensuring adherence to the project plan.
Identify deviations from expected timelines or specifications and define/remediate action plans.
Drive weekly installation reporting cadence and provide updates to internal teams.
Maintain installation evidence and ensure proper documentation is stored and accessible.
Serve as a point of contact for escalations and troubleshooting during install phases.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, and Support to ensure alignment.
Ensure installation partners are trained and follow Samsara standards.
Monitor CSAT related to installation events and resolve root causes of dissatisfaction.
Provide proactive communication and transparency with customers during install projects.
Define and continuously improve the installation coordination process using AI and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) tools to enhance efficiency and scale globally.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

Experience in field operations coordination, customer implementation, or technical deployment.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple installs in parallel.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in Spanish and English (verbal and written).
Comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with cross-functional collaboration.

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization, automation and AI, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment.
Possesses strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
Has familiarity or hands-on experience with AI and RPA tools to drive operational efficiency.
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.




Marketing Associate, Bone Franchise (Fixed Term, 2 Years)




What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will:




Brand planning and performance

Implement the Country Brand Plan in alignment with the International Brand Plan and local business priorities.
Analyze market research, brand performance, market trends, competitive activity, and customer insights to identify opportunities and contribute to the development of the Plan of Action (POA).
Monitor key performance indicators and prepare brand updates and analyses for the Brand Team.
Support the planning and tracking of budgets for assigned initiatives.

 Marketing and communications execution

Coordinate promotional activities, including detailing materials, message scripts, campaigns, congresses, and other approved initiatives.
Implement brand campaigns locally, adapting messages and materials to market needs.
Coordinate the development, review, and timely availability of materials for the Sales Force in collaboration with relevant internal functions.
Support cycle meetings, launch meetings, and other communication and training activities to strengthen the Sales Force’s brand knowledge and connection to the brand aspiration.

 Medical collaboration and field activities

Partner with Medical Affairs on initiatives related to clinical messages, continuous medical education, and external expert development, respecting each function’s roles and responsibilities.
Support Sales Force activities such as field visits, KOL mapping, and continuous medical education activities, according to business priorities and applicable processes.
Work with internal teams to develop training materials and other information that help the Sales Force execute initiatives effectively.

 Vendor, process, and compliance management

Coordinate assigned external vendors end to end, including scope, timelines, deliverables, follow-up, and documentation.
Ensure complete and timely documentation of promotional and continuous medical education activities, with strong attention to detail.
Track approvals, contracts, purchase orders, and other administrative processes related to assigned initiatives, in collaboration with the responsible functions.
Carry out activities in accordance with internal procedures, regulatory requirements, and applicable compliance policies.

 Outputs

Brand DOE budget.
Support in country brand plans.
Sales support tools. (Promomats, C3, Cvent, Veeva)
Promotional campaign.
Marketing events.
Brand Performance.
Business presentations for Brand/Franchise/Country Reviews.




What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is a type of person with these qualifications.




Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or multinational or national environments.
Professional working proficiency in English is required and will be assessed throughout the interview process.




Preferred Qualifications:

Strong organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
Analytical skills and ability to interpret market data and insights.
Cross-functional collaboration and clear communication.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
Customer, patient, and brand focus.
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Demonstrates accountability and sound decision-making in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.




What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com




As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

description:
Orion Innovation is a premier, award-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education.

Digital Analytics Analyst Jr.



Buscamos un(a) Digital Analytics Analyst Jr. con interés en desarrollar su carrera en analítica digital dentro del ecosistema eCommerce. Participarás en la implementación, validación y monitoreo de la medición digital, así como en el análisis del comportamiento de usuarios para generar insights que apoyen la toma de decisiones de negocio.

Trabajarás de forma cercana con equipos de Producto, Tecnología y Marketing en proyectos orientados a mejorar la experiencia digital y la conversión.

Requisitos:

Formación en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Actuaría, Matemáticas, Economía, Marketing, Negocios o carreras afines.



Recién egresado(a) o con hasta 1–2 años de experiencia en analítica digital, eCommerce, marketing digital, business intelligence, datos o áreas relacionadas.

Interés por desarrollar conocimientos en analítica digital, medición y comportamiento de usuarios.

Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle y facilidad para trabajar con datos.

Capacidad para identificar patrones o inconsistencias y comunicar hallazgos de forma clara.

Organización, curiosidad, iniciativa para aprender y facilidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.



Google Analytics 4 — básico/intermedio

Google Tag Manager — básico

Looker Studio — básico/intermedio

SQL / BigQuery — básico

KPIs digitales

Fundamentos de Data Layer

Tag Assistant / debugging

Excel / Google Sheets

HTML / JavaScript — deseable

Comunicación de insights





Principales responsabilidades

Apoyar en la implementación, configuración y validación de la medición digital mediante Google Tag Manager (GTM) y Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

Monitorear la calidad del tracking, identificar incidencias y colaborar en su corrección junto con equipos técnicos.

Analizar el comportamiento de usuarios, funnels de conversión y KPIs digitales para generar insights de negocio.

Crear y mantener dashboards y reportes en Looker Studio, así como realizar consultas básicas en SQL/BigQuery.

Colaborar con equipos de Producto, Tecnología y Marketing para asegurar una medición confiable y el seguimiento del desempeño digital.

Participar en la mejora continua de procesos, documentación, eventos y estrategias de medición.

Ubicación de la vacante: Cd. De México Hibrido (asistir 3 veces por semana en sitio en Reforma)

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for an Executive who will:


Interact effectively with regional teams and be a strong communicator.   
Support digital media campaign launches and setup according to established processes.   
Monitor and report on digital media campaign checks across channels/platforms.   
Ensure data accuracy for campaign reporting tools and WPP Media campaign management software.   
Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting and providing commentary to regional teams.  


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 
Excellent communication, both written and verbal. 
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.
